source_mapping: Authoritative /spec/source.txt: Research/Projects/BinaryTreeReduction/DotProduct.lean defines exactProductTree as the shape-preserving map of exact pair products, roundedProductTree as the map of Model.mul, and roundedDotProduct as roundedSum of roundedProductTree. The target universally quantifies over every supplied Model and every Tree (Real × Real); its only additional assumption is ((tree.depth + 1 : Nat) : Real) * model.u < 1. It concludes existence of a same-shape tree of perturbed exact products with leafwise relative error at most gamma (tree.depth + 1) model.u and exact sum equal to the rounded dot product, covering multiplication and addition rounding. All five supporting sources were copied byte-for-byte unchanged. Statement revision record: initial statement; /spec/feedback.json absent; no revision. The final theorem proof is temporary sorry scaffolding for the next proof role; all three construction definitions have actual bodies.
